name: Alternative Energy Technology, Inc.
summary: Alternative Energy Technology, Inc. (ATNE) is a technology enterprise specializing in the development of sustainable energy solutions, including advanced biofuels and other alternative energy innovations. The company is strategically focused on creating technologies that harness renewable inputs derived from non-food sources, aiming to fulfill the future energy demands of the United States and global markets as the world transitions away from fossil fuels. A key aspect of its operations involves integrated systems designed to convert abundant cellulosic plant materials into diverse fuel products. Established in 2002 and based in Houston, Texas, the firm was formerly known as The Alternative Energy Technology Center, Inc., before officially adopting its current name in August 2008.
